safeResponse: I can help organize what you already have and flag questions for a licensed professional to review. I cannot say whether your current coverage is adequate.
I can list cost-related factors to discuss with a licensed professional, such as limits, deductibles, and optional coverages. I cannot recommend reducing coverage or select a product.
A licensed professional must review any request to start, bind, or change coverage. I can prepare a handoff summary without submitting or binding anything.
This demo uses synthetic data only. In a real system, collection of documents or credentials would require approved secure intake controls and consent.
